profile_md: Research at USC (reduced depth, about 14 searches plus page fetches) found team-based client projects concentrated in particular schools rather than an institution-wide scheme. The Price School of Public Policy has the clearest routes: the two-semester MPP Policy Analysis Practicum (small teams working for named government, UN, think-tank and some commercial clients, with a client-approved proposal and reports) and the compulsory 4-unit MPA capstone PPD 546 (teams of three or four per search-indexed Price Online text, with an organizational client). Marshall's BUAD 114 Global Social Impact is a team consulting project for a company partner, but is limited to first-year World Bachelor in Business students. The Iovine and Young Academy Industry Practicum (ACAD 376) and Annenberg think tank courses involve company or community partners, but team basis and standard external-client coverage are not documented; the only dated ACAD 376 example used internal USC units as clients. The legacy Joint Educational Project (Dornsife) is service-learning placement at schools and non-profits and no bounded team project was evidenced. Engineering senior design (AME, EE 459Lx) is team-based but without documented external sponsors. None of the three routes meeting all criteria could be confirmed as current by a dated 2025/26 or 2026/27 source, so all are 'Current status unclear'. Participation numbers were not published in the sources found.
gaps: No dated 2025/26-2026/27 evidence for S2, S3, S4 (pages undated; uscpriceonline.usc.edu and publicadmin.usc.edu did not resolve via WebFetch, so MPA group/client evidence is search-index only). Not researched: Viterbi CS/ISE capstones (e.g. CSCI 401, ISE), Gould Law clinics, Keck/health, Social Work field placements (individual placements likely), Roski, Cinematic Arts, Architecture, Kaufman, Dornsife departmental capstones (GEOL 387a, Anthropology), Lloyd Greif Center, Marshall MOR 462, BUAD 493. Further departmental instances likely.
